facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2019-0019 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 12 January 2019 as a scheduled change under management of change; no event precedes it in the record. The management of change record covers 1 clause across 2 controlled documents. The intent is to introduce a duty the documents in scope did not previously carry. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the critical control set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are PRO-HSE-005 and STD-HTW-004.
